sources.name: anudeepND whitelist
sources.note: Domains commonly caught by overzealous blocklists. Used only to find hosts that are missing from the catalog; the allowlist concept itself is not part of this repository.

sources.name: anudeepND optional
sources.note: Second anudeepND list. Grouped under the same maintainer; both files are read so their coverage differences stay visible.

sources.name: DuckDuckGo Tracker Radar
sources.reason: NC: a commercial app may not use it. SA: the derivative would stop being CC0, which is what this repository offers. Listed so the decision stays visible rather than being rediscovered.

sources.name: Disconnect.me
sources.reason: Same as DuckDuckGo Tracker Radar: NC and ShareAlike both conflict with shipping CC0 data inside a commercial app.

sources.name: VirusTotal domain categories
sources.reason: Not a licence problem: the VT Public API must not be used in commercial products or services, and this catalog ships inside one. The Premium API is a different commercial agreement, not a free tier. If you hold a Premium agreement that permits this use, change this record to allowed: true and say so in the reason.

sources.name: Cisco Umbrella Investigate — domain categorization
sources.reason: Usable for evidence gathering: the endpoint returns a label under Cisco's own terms, not a dataset we redistribute. Cisco announced end of sale for Umbrella SIG/DNS on 2026-09-01, so treat cached evidence as the durable artefact rather than the service.
